glosses: nicht exakt auf das Ziel gerichtet

examples.text: Der unplatzierte Schuss konnte vom Torwart gehalten werden.

glosses: keinen vorderen Rang bei einem Wettbewerb besetzend

translations.source_sense_description: keinen vorderen Rang bei einem Wettbewerb besetzend

examples.text:
For none of these I write, and none of these
Could read the writing if they deigned to try;
So may they flourish in their due degrees,
On our sweet earth and in their unplaced sky.
Until more detailed phylogenetic work is done to elucidate their true relationships, it seems best to leave all these species unplaced.

glosses: Not among the first three horses to finish a race.

examples.text: The Listed John Dillon Stakes (1400m) at Caulfield on Australia Day is an option for Rok Posta, who has only been unplaced four times in his 20 starts.
